name: v11.5.5
body:
## What's Changed
* perf: walk requested chunk ranges instead of expanding every offset by @4RH1T3CT0R7 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1353
* fix: prevent stalled stored uploads from blocking new transfers by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1356
* fix: update stored download progress as bytes arrive by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1357
* fix: draw the invitation focus ring around the whole field by @576576 in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1360
* fix: preserve relay client ips with host publishing by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1375
* fix: reserve local relay listeners before startup by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1376
* fix: keep forward-slash paths in signed Windows zip by @costajohnt in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1377
* fix: limit pending relay handshakes per source by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1378
* chore: reserve relay replacement port for disco by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1374
* chore: upgrade tailcat by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1379

## New Contributors
* @576576 made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1360
* @Totara-thib made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1366

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.5.4...v11.5.5
